metadata.description: Plugins that connect Claude Code and Codex to Silo Systems apps for Mac.

plugins.name: silo-vault
plugins.description: Search PDFs, notes and spreadsheets indexed in Silo Vault for Mac, then read source passages for cited answers. Requires Silo Vault from the Mac App Store.

plugins.name: silo-redact
plugins.description: Redact a PDF with Silo Redact for Mac, from the Mac App Store, before your assistant reads it. The plugin tells your assistant to work only from the copy Silo Redact verified.
